gaps.explanation: No proprietary schedule in detail[]. pp10-11 Statement of Revenues, Expenses and Changes in Net Position - Proprietary Funds, Business-type Activities enterprise columns: Environmental Services (Charges for services 3,261,940, Other revenues 17,992, Investment income (144,390)), Wastewater (2,827,417, 8,865, (128,517)), Water (2,391,595, 80,310, (242,498)), Electric (3,233,578, investment (70,412)), Stormwater (135,866, 56,920, (32,525)) = 11,396,141. JSON business-type receipts 11,392,967 = the Totals column (charges 11,850,396 + other 164,087 + investment (621,516)), which also contains the business-type Internal Service column (investment income (3,175)). Residual 11,392,967 - 11,396,141 = -3,174 = Internal Service (3,175) + 1 rounding in the printed Totals (columns add to (621,517), printed (621,516)). Internal service funds are not added (rule), so the gap is closed except for that printed Internal Service amount; no derived line added.
